name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the response is relevant to the context and the previous message in the conversation.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant

name: Engagement
description: The degree to which the response encourages further conversation and interaction.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is very disengaging and 5 is highly engaging

name: Clarity
description: The clarity and coherence of the response, including the use of clear and understandable language.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is very unclear and 5 is extremely clear

name: Naturalness
description: The natural flow and conversational tone of the response.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is very unnatural and 5 is highly natural

name: Insightfulness
description: The depth and insightfulness of the response, including the ability to provide new or interesting information.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not insightful at all and 5 is highly insightful

name: Empathy
description: The degree to which the response demonstrates empathy and understanding towards the other person.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is not empathetic at all and 5 is highly empathetic

name: Specificity
description: The specificity and detail in the response, including the use of specific examples or details.
scale: 1-5, where 1 is very vague and 5 is highly specific
